title: Design: the Export menu matches the design picture
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Open the design picture "Export menu: PDF and CSV" (ar-ap-p2-export-menu-pdf-and-csv.png) (attached to this case) beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
custom_steps: 1. Click the ⋯ button at the right of the title row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens, as in the picture: while the menu is open the ⋯ button shows a light-grey square.
  • The white menu with a shadow opens under it, its right edge lined up with the button, over the right end of the column headings.
  • Its rows read, letter for letter, "Download (PDF)" then "Download (CSV)", nothing else.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S3-R1: “Each of the six reports has the native report Export menu (the ⋯ button at the right of the title row, labelled "Export report") with "Download (PDF)" and "Download (CSV)". A/R's former Print button is replaced by this menu. The A/P reports gain a PDF.”
  • Key Decisions, reuse rule: “The reuse rule. Every control on these reports reuses an existing ShopView pattern: the native filter chips, the native totals row and pinned headline column of the newer reports, the existing location-switch prompt, the design system's chevron icon. Nothing new is drawn. Basis: d-reuse-existing-pattern.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 2 "Export" (board Export.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p2-export-menu-pdf-and-csv.png: figure "Export menu: PDF and CSV" (This build (after)), board "2. Export"
  • ar-ap-p2-a-p-no-export-at-all.png: figure "A/P: no export at all" (Production (before)), board "2. Export" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "The native ⋯ Export menu on all six reports. Files hold exactly the rows on screen, in screen order, with the as-of date and locations, then Past due and the customer or vendor when chosen. S3-R1 to S3-R8, S3-R8a." (caption of "Export menu: PDF and CSV")
  • "The A/P reports have no print, PDF or CSV." (caption of "A/P: no export at all")
